description:
Download or export generated content from NotebookLM.

Supported content types:
- audio_overview: Downloads as audio file (MP3)
- video: Downloads as video file
- infographic: Downloads as image file
- presentation: Exports to Google Slides (returns URL)
- data_table: Exports to Google Sheets (returns URL)

Note: Report content is text-based and returned in the generation response.

notebook_url.description: Notebook URL. If not provided, uses the active notebook.

output_path.description: Optional local path to save the file (for audio, video, infographic)

session_id.description: Session ID to reuse an existing session

name: content_download

data.description: The tool payload on success. The exact shape depends on the tool.

error.description: Human-readable error message, present only when success is false.
